responsibility: Implementation of Objective-C type and metadata string encoding rules used by the front end and runtime emitters. It converts GCC tree types, method declarations, fields, and properties into Objective-C runtime encodings for method prototypes, @encode expressions, ivar/type descriptors, bit-fields, and Objective-C 2 property attribute strings, handling runtime-dependent details such as GNU versus NeXT bitfield formats and using a shared obstack to produce identifier or string constants consumed by metadata generation.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the objc-encoding pair: this .c file actually computes Objective-C encoding strings for methods, fields, @encode expressions, bit-fields, and property attributes, maintaining the obstack-based encoder state and runtime-specific formatting logic. Unlike gcc/objc/objc-encoding.h, it performs the encoding work instead of only declaring the API and shared mode/state symbols.
